payloads.name: YetAnotherControllerEnabler
payloads.description: YetAnotherControllerEnabler is a homebrew payload for a PS5. It lets a controller from another console play on the PS5 by publishing a virtual DualSense and filling that pad with the other controller's buttons and sticks. The console treats the virtual pad like a DualSense: it can be assigned to a player, and games read it as a normal controller.
